=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:579-584 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The escalate() latch comment tells a human to "reply `/answer` to resume it now", but after escalation the issue has only `ai:waiting-on-dependency` and `ai:needs-human`, and plan.yml's phase gate (.github/workflows/plan.yml:981-1001) accepts only `ai:planning`, `ai:clarification` or `ai:blocked`, so it logs `reason=missing_expected_phase_label outcome=skip` and sets `SKIP_PLAN=true`.
  WHY: A human who follows the instruction gets a skipped plan run and the issue stays parked; for `invalid_escalate` targets the human `/answer` is the only way out, so these issues stay stuck for good (all four reviewers rated it MAJOR).
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:561-565 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In resume(), the wait label is removed before the resume marker exists; if `gh.comment()` fails and the rollback `gh.add_labels(issue.number, [WAIT_LABEL])` also fails, the `and` short-circuit skips `gh.remove_label(BLOCKED_LABEL)`, and the function returns the generic `read_failed`.
  WHY: The issue is left with only `ai:blocked`, no wait label and no resume marker, so it drops out of the waiting scan; `seed_candidate()` recovers it only when the body has exactly one `Depends on: #N` line, so `pr` and `release` waits stay stuck with no log trace (all five reviewers rated it MAJOR).
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:544-549 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: resume() posts `/answer [auto-answered-by-poller]`, but plan.yml's Bot-author branch (.github/workflows/plan.yml:41-50) accepts only `[auto-answered-by-clarify]` or `[auto-answered-by-orchestrator]`, so a Bot-authored comment (for example from a GitHub App bot or a bot-owned GH_PAT) is rejected after the label has already been swapped to `ai:blocked`.
  WHY: The resolved wait stays in `ai:blocked` and planning never starts. All three flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR. Disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dropped or refuted this in their pass-1 notes, because GH_PAT is a User token whose comments go through plan.yml branch 1 (lines 28-39), and the suffix is already used in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh.
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:613-623 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The seed_blocked() recovery branch puts back any valid, unresumed trusted wait marker without checking `found[1].get("source") == "seed"` or that `found[1]["number"]` equals the `dependency` parsed from the current `Depends on: #N` line.
  WHY: A stale marker target is re-waited while the log reports `issue:{repo}#{dependency}` from the body, and a deliberate human move back to `ai:blocked` is undone within one poll interval (all three reviewers rated it NIT).
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:619-620, 633-634 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The seed path adds `ai:waiting-on-dependency`, but that label is missing from .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json and scripts/label_helpers.sh, and the code does not create it before adding it.
  WHY: On repositories without the label the add-label request fails, so the issue stays `ai:blocked` (possibly after the seed comment has already posted) and never enters the waiting scan.
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:49 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The label `ai:waiting-on-dependency` (WAIT_LABEL) gates the resume flow but is not registered in the project's label contract.
  WHY: Standalone stall recovery may conflict with the wait state, and tests such as test_orchestrate_lib.py fail.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:Multiple test failures (test_dispatchable_workflows_match_the_gh_workflow_run_allow_rules, etc.) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new poller step runs scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py, which makes gh api calls that violate the permission guard hook configuration.
  WHY: The permission guard will block the unattended poller step during real runs (rated BLOCKER). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash noted they could not map this failure to any changed hunk.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:326 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The file was changed even though it is outside the approved files_touched list in the linked issue's plan grant.
  WHY: The files-touched scope guard rejects the PR, so CI fails (rated BLOCKER).
- scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py:escalate() return path | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: escalate() returns `"waiting"` while the issue carries `ai:waiting-on-dependency` and `ai:needs-human`; when a human then posts `/answer`, plan.yml sets `SKIP_PLAN=true`, and nothing in the script's logs ties the human reply to the missed resume.
  WHY: The trail is split between plan.yml's `AI_PHASE_GATE_V1 ... outcome=skip` line and the script's `outcome=waiting` log, with no shared marker to link them.
- agents.d/stuck-states-p8b-dependency-wait-resume.md:3 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fragment says plan.yml's `/answer` gate moves `ai:blocked → ai:planning` and that the rollback always succeeds, but the move depends on the comment author being `user.type == 'User'` without the bot suffixes, and the short-circuit at lines 562-564 can leave a partial state.
  WHY: Readers and editorial bots take the documented transition at face value, and when it does not fire there is no diagnostic trail.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
